text:
alex (Platform): hey infra/runtime/security — pinging for quick eyes on PR #25678. Changes the eviction path to prefer memory-pinned BPF pages for certain low-latency flows. blocking canary tomorrow unless we get approvals. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/25678

maya (Runtime): looking now. quick Q: are we falling back to normal pages if pinned allocation fails?

alex (Platform): yes, there's a fallback that retries with normal alloc and logs. I added a metric `evict.pinned_fallback_count`.

maya (Runtime): ok good. can you paste the perf delta for tail latency? microbench would help.

alex (Platform): added results in PR comment — median same, p99 improved ~12ms on our test workload. also added a brief note about KV cache interactions.

tara (Infra): fyi this touches kernel pinned pages. need to confirm node sysctl defaults. can you add an opt-in toggle and an ops doc? something like: `sysctl vm.max_map_count` and `echo 1 > /proc/sys/vm/your_toggle` (placeholder).

alex (Platform): yeah adding a toggle and ops runbook now. will add a config flag `enable_pinned_eviction` default false for Dedicated and Private.

sam (Security): quick ask from sec: include a short threat model blurb — does pinned memory change exposure surface (page ownership, creds)? also ensure no secrets are pinned inadvertently.

alex (Platform): good call — I'll add a threat-model section and confirm we don't pin any secret buffers.

maya (Runtime): skimming code: one minor nit — prefer `ScopedPinGuard` to ensure release on error path. leaving comment on PR.

alex (Platform): fixed and pushed. thanks.

tara (Infra): I'll validate the sysctl/daemon approach tomorrow morning. if infra approves, i can sign off for infra side.

sam (Security): once the threat note is in and CI SCA passes, i'm happy to give security ack. leaving a TODO in PR for SCA.

deploy-bot: canary deploy window: 2026-03-18 09:00 UTC (requires approvals by 2026-03-17 20:00 UTC) :warning:

alex (Platform): noted. aiming for approvals before EOD today. tagging @maya @tara @sam — any blockers?

maya (Runtime): no blockers beyond my small comment — i'll re-review after push.

tara (Infra): no blockers from infra besides verifying sysctl impact. will update PR.

sam (Security): will recheck after threat-model blurb + SCA.

alex (Platform): awesome — thanks everyone. if all good i'll queue this into the EOD merge window. :thumbsup:
